title: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.19190v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-to-sim conversion for robotic interaction with objects remains labor-intensive because it requires more than visual reconstruction: a streamlined real2sim process must recover scene geometries and object states, infer physical parameters, and assemble actors, objects, cameras, poses, and trajectories into a runnable physical simulation. Today this process still depends on brittle workflow glue across visual perception tools and simulators: manual tuning of visual foundation models, mesh cleanup, coordinate frame alignments, etc. We introduce \textit{Agentic Real2Sim}, a framework for generalized physical world modeling with vision-language agents that converts a real-world recording of object-robot interaction into a simulatable episodic twin, and connects the resulting twin to downstream policy fine-tuning and evaluation. We evaluate Agentic Real2Sim on rigid-object manipulation, deformable-object interaction, and humanoi

translated_title: 智能体化真实到仿真转换：基于视觉-语言智能体的物理世界建模
translated_abstract: 面向机器人与物体交互的真实到仿真转换仍然非常耗费人力，因为它所需要的远不止视觉重建：一个精简的real2sim流程必须恢复场景几何结构与物体状态，推断物理参数，并将智能体、物体、相机、姿态和轨迹组装成一个可运行的物理仿真。如今，这一过程仍然依赖于连接视觉感知工具与仿真器之间脆弱的工作流粘合：手动调整视觉基础模型、网格清理、坐标系对齐等等。我们提出了Agentic Real2Sim，这是一个利用视觉-语言智能体进行通用物理世界建模的框架，它能够将物体-机器人交互的真实世界记录转换为可仿真的情景孪生体，并将生成的孪生体与下游的策略微调和评估相连接。我们在刚性物体操作、可变形物体交互以及人形（机器人）任务上对Agentic Real2Sim进行了评估。
tldr: 提出Agentic Real2Sim框架，利用视觉-语言智能体自动将真实世界中物体-机器人交互的记录转换为可仿真的物理孪生体，摆脱了传统real2sim流程中繁琐的手动调参与工具拼接，并支持下游策略微调与评估。
